scope: Offline software contracts, current module compilation and complete source replay

probe.scope: Explicit 20 MHz STA dwell probes; unsupported packet controls rejected

limits: Complete production state core and header execute; only Linux types/includes are adapted for host compilation.
All 24 STARTED/FOREIGN/EXIT/terminal callback orders, stale attribution, deadlines, cancellation and invalidation are tested.
Caller serialization and callback-context lifetime are contracts, not concurrent kernel or radio validation.
Target timestamps are optional local ordering observations, not TSF/QTIMER or proof of RF entry timing.
Revocation intentionally latches until terminal; scan re-entry needs a new reservation.
Negative controls change temporary translation units only, never production files.
Complete production dwell/coex sources and headers execute; provider packet publication wrappers are extracted from production.
MLME routing/admission, object manager, scan request services, scheduler and module pins are explicit host mocks; actual MLME scan routing has separate injection fixture coverage.
Host pthread admission and dwell locks check publication serialization against an EXIT event; this is not a kernel race or radio test.
The actual RX netdev callback gate executes while publication locks are held; provider teardown revocation before gate removal is checked against source wiring.
Actual foreign-channel preflight requires explicit probe opt-in, STA ownership and regulatory 20 MHz approval; denied preflight does not reserve scans or rewrite HOME.
Packets queued for an old same-frequency tuple, failed/expired scans, HOME and unknown-frequency publication, and teardown context pins are checked.
Firmware timing, scan-manager internals, WMI/DMA transfer ownership and device behavior are excluded.
Negative controls modify temporary translation units only.
Uses actual cfg80211 radiotap iterator, frame parser and HTT encoder.
Actual WMA queue, refill, lookup, completion/release, init, stop and coex-resume functions use mocked scheduling/DP.
Actual MLME READY, ownership, snapshot and generation checks cover restart and failed-drain admission.
Actual triple-owner controller checks cover malformed ownership, both owners management, companion invalidation/CSA and leases through native drain; HDD/radio admission is excluded.

Actual private WMA power cache, layout and admission functions cover zero/negative limits, failed/overlapping sends, regulatory changes, overrides and vdev reuse with mocked regulatory and object services.
Actual native helper START continuation and UP gate reject missing/failed/stale TPC programming; WMI sends and vdev state-machine delivery are mocked.
Helper MAC selection and snapshot identity use actual WMA functions; firmware address handling needs device testing.

Actual Wonder helper preparation/identity and channel-change guards cover same-frequency width transitions and DELETE timeout with mocked helper creation/deletion and module pins; HDD matcher CLEAR is excluded.
Actual provider vdev admission and standalone helper reservation remain blocked after provider teardown until helper deletion drains; vdev creation itself is mocked.

Actual DP measured-frequency capture and final coex publication helpers cover exact PPDU identity, HOME fallback exclusion, stale owner/binding rejection, and balanced admission held through the callback; the owner lease implementation and RX rings/DMA are mocked.

Actual HDD ownership predicate, monitor push selector and OSIF network delivery defer Wonder consumption until admission/RCU/monitor locks release; normal monitors retain immediate NAPI/BH delivery. Network consumers and backlog are mocked; a compiled negative control detects recursive Wonder consumption under its held lease.
Native helper creation/STOP/DELETE, HDD channel setup, SKBs, DMA and synchronization primitives are mocks or excluded; firmware, races, ACKs and WPS require device testing.

cases: disabled/non1 environment and unrelated symbol pass-through

limits: Android links use installed NDK28.2 / API35 compatibility stubs; this is not a full Evolution/Soong product build.
